title: Working the Alexandria district and its houses
summary: Love recalls the district's 18 bands, the musicians who worked in them, and the madams he worked for.

story.theme_name: Chicago: the jazz migration and its clubs

blocks.x: Yeah, strictly a faker. He played them right just like the real musicians and he heard them so much, you know. We used to play them every night. We'd work in a district over that body there, you know. That was the district there. About 18 bands over there. Pensacola, Kid from Florida. He was a good violin player. And Zoo Robinson, trombone player. He used to know.
He worked with Baby Lovett and Mo Johnson, Pensacola Kid, and Willie Reed, bass player. Used to work for Miss, let me see,
Lucille Agnes. I used to work for Pines and Blanches. I worked two, three different places, Pines and Blanches, Miss B. Nichols, Lucille Wilson.
These were all the madams, huh?
